requested_delta: Create one public, non-authoritative Worker Lab that continuously exposes worker lessons, historical experiments, current run metrics, delays/failures, capacity observations and next tests without replacing worker contracts, Work Graph, scoreboard, RUN/POOL or Design DNA.
problem_evidence: Worker knowledge is durable but fragmented across playbook, evolution lab, local batch observations, I/O accounting, RUN receipts and historical chat reconstruction.
Human requested one readable page/blog showing how the worker evolved, what slowed it down, what improved it, how much it can produce and how long it remains productive.
A local admission-canary decision obscured the wider parallel evaluation program, showing the need for a single synthesis surface.
must_preserve: Binding worker contracts remain authority; Worker Lab is derived only.
Historical chat/file reconstruction is labeled candidate/history unless backed by durable receipts.
Self-reported timing remains diagnostic, not wall-clock evidence.
ACTIVE/PARKED is never presented as liveness.
No private raw prompts, transcripts, secrets or credentials are published.
Current run metrics derive from durable claims/midpoints/receipts/status.
forbidden_regressions: Worker Lab becoming a routing authority.
Converting hypotheses into binding laws without experiment/promotion.
Using word count alone as productivity.
promotion_gate: Public projection contains no private raw transcript.
Current RUN counts match durable artifacts.
No mutation authority is granted by page/projection.
Mobile page remains readable and sparse.
truth_boundary: Public observability and knowledge projection only.
